# CircStat subset

This folder contains five unchanged functions from Philipp Berens' MATLAB Circular Statistics Toolbox:

- `circ_ang2rad.m`
- `circ_confmean.m`
- `circ_mean.m`
- `circ_r.m`
- `circ_rad2ang.m`

Immediate source: `Codes/BNT-master/externals/CircStat2012a` in the supplied analysis source. The source directory has no retained Git metadata; its label is not asserted to be an upstream release tag.

Upstream project: [circstat/circstat-matlab](https://github.com/circstat/circstat-matlab).

The original BSD two-clause license, including copyright (c) 2011 Philipp Berens and its disclaimer, is included in [CircStat_LICENSE.txt](CircStat_LICENSE.txt). Original author notices in the function files are retained. Redistribution must retain these notices and the license; the BNT GPL notice does not replace them.

Reference: Philipp Berens (2009), *CircStat: A MATLAB Toolbox for Circular Statistics*, Journal of Statistical Software, 31(10), [doi:10.18637/jss.v031.i10](https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v031.i10).

The project software license is provided in [LICENSE](../../LICENSE). The separate CircStat BSD terms and original author notices remain in force.
